GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight. When questioned regarding his riding in the early stages of the home straight explained that he normally is a very patient rider and with the strong headwind today was reluctant to expose his mount sooner than he did to ensure the gelding’s finishing effort.
